caption_english: Synthetic differences on 120 matched IDs, retaining all observations. Half-violin uses Gaussian KDE with Scott bandwidth; dot, thick line and thin line give median, IQR and 10–90% quantiles. Jitter affects only horizontal position. The ECDF includes all paired differences. Neither distribution display nor quantile is an effect CI.
